scientific.integrity: The stochastic law is derived from a direct last-vertex recursion and independently stress-tested by exhaustive permutation enumeration. Prior maximal-independent-set enumeration is credited explicitly rather than presented as new, and residual literature-indexing risk is retained.
limitations: The exact law is proved only for threshold graphs represented by an isolated/dominating creation sequence.
The finite exhaustive checker corroborates the formulas through order seven but is not used as the proof of the infinite statement.

The support classification of maximal independent sets is already covered by prior enumeration work; the claimed contribution is the exact random-greedy weighting, distribution recurrence, and optimality probability.

title: Exact random-greedy independent-set law on threshold graphs
